incident-bot: PAGER — Billing metering anomaly detected (P1)
incident-bot: symptom=token-count drift, scope=eu-west-1, affected_customers~=50, overage_flags=true
incident-bot: runbook=https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-drift alert_id=INC-1759402460

maria (oncall): oncall here, investigating emitter -> ingest path. starting quick queries and checking Kafka consumer groups

sam (billing-sre): looking at proxy/emitter logs now. seeing repeated retries with `emit_id=null` for a subset of clients. running quick count query: `SELECT count(*) FROM emits WHERE emit_id IS NULL AND region='eu-west-1' AND ts > now() - interval '5 minutes'`

maria (oncall): repro log snippet:
```
emit: {client_id: "cust-42", emit_id: null, retry_count: 3, source: "proxy-batch"}
```
maria (oncall): hypothesis: upstream rate-limiter returned 503, proxy retried but dropped/failed to propagate dedupe header on retry path -> duplicates in ledger

sam (billing-sre): mitigation plan: enforce dedupe header in proxy (reject if missing) and pause shadow replay to stop replay amplification. preparing canary deploy now

jordan (ops-lead): customer-impact? which accounts got overage flags so CS can reach out and freeze billing

nina (customer-success): pulling list from billing db. initial: 12 customers with immediate overage flags, 3 enterprise accounts. prepping a short triage note + temporary credits template. will post to #support and DM affected CSMs :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam (billing-sre): canary deployed to two proxy hosts (canary-02/03). metrics: token delta dropping from +18% -> +2% in 45s. pushing 100% rollout now

maria (oncall): 100% rollout done, shadow replay paused, consumer lag cleared. monitoring graphs (tokens_ingested / shadow_tokens) trending back to baseline. keeping thread open for 15m for stability window

nina (customer-success): messages queued and sent to impacted customers, we offered temporary credits and a follow-up postmortem ETA. customers acknowledged, one asked for immediate invoice hold

jordan (ops-lead): good containment. please prepare incident postmortem (root cause=dropped dedupe header on retry path) and a billing reconciliation run to remove false overage flags. assign owners

maria (oncall): assigning postmortem owner: sam (billing-sre) + maria (oncall). will gather logs and the list of affected invoice IDs

incident-bot: Incident status changed -> mitigated (recovering). Will auto-close if no regression in 15 minutes.

[notes] quick commands used: `k exec -c proxy -- grep emit_id /var/log/proxy.log | head -n 50` ; `psql -c "SELECT customer_id FROM billing.overages WHERE alert_ts > now() - interval '1 hour'"`

[tags] #billing #metering #pager #oncall
